title: FRQ (a): below-freezing count
prompt: A weather station stores one reading per hour. Part (a): implement `belowFreezing(double[] readings)` returning the **count of readings strictly below 0.0**. The array may be empty (return 0).

tests.name: freezing count
tests.hint: One accumulator; strictly less than 0.0 (0.0 itself does not count).
